newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco jails Briton, arrests Dutch for drugs.
newsitem.headline: Morocco jails Briton, arrests Dutch for drugs.

text.p: A Moroccan court sentenced a British national to four years imprisonment and fined him $4,070 on drug charges, Moroccan anti-drugs officials said on Thursday.

The man identified as Derek Russel Powell, 28, from Basingstoke, England, was arrested last Sunday after police found 104 kgs (228 lbs) of cannabis hidden in the double roof of his car. He was sentenced on Wednesday.
Three Dutch and two Moroccans with a total of more than 285 kgs (627 lbs) of cannabis were arrested in the northern cities of Nador and Tangier in separate operations, they added.
Two of the Dutch nationals, Ronny Engel and Wilhemine Van Din Heuvel, had 143.6 kgs (315 lbs) of cannabis in their vehicle, police said. No details were available of their hometown or itinerary.

The Moroccan news agency MAP said police added that the pair were travelling with a child to try to avert suspicion. The third Dutch national, Christian Roland Ligterkink, had 21.1 kgs (48 lbs) of cannabis concealed in his car doors.
The remainder of the total haul was divided between the two Moroccans.
Morocco said recently that more than 500 foreign nationals were arrested on drug-related charges in 1994-1995.
